note: Description taken from Hill's 1925 original description of Eutermes centraliensis (in English), including the soldier, worker and first-instar nymph; alate unknown; type locality central Australia (collected by Drs. Horne & Nicholls). The original is in English and the BHL scan was OCR'd, with occasional misread hyphens and measurement digits (e.g. the hyphen ¬), restored here from context; values that cannot be determined are not cited. The species was then placed in Eutermes and is now in Nasutitermes.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Only the soldier, worker and first-instar nymph are known; the soldier head is nearly spherical with a short nasus (about one third the length of the rest of the head) and 13-segmented antennae, body length 4.00 mm; pilosity very sparse, and the yellow-brown head and body with a much darker nasus are distinctive. It differs from E. pyriformis in the distinctly sparser pilosity of head and body, the shorter and concolorous nasus, and the 13-segmented (not 14-segmented) antennae with shorter segments.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule reddish brown to yellowish brown, nasus deep date-red; anterior part of the pronotum and the abdominal tergites cinnamon-brown. Head medium-sized, nearly spherical in dorsal view, with very few bristles; nasus short and slightly thick, about one third the length of the rest of the head; lateral outline of the head almost straight. Antennae 13-segmented, the segments moderately long and slender: segment 2 shorter than segment 3 and only slightly shorter than segment 4; segment 5 and the following segments long and slender, segment 13 slightly shorter than segment 12. Pronotum small, the anterior half dark, with few bristles. Legs long and slender. Abdomen dark, with few bristles except at the end. Measurements: body length 4.00 mm; head length 1.70—1.82 mm; head width 1.14—1.19 mm; head height 0.68—0.74 mm; pronotum length 0.28 mm, width 0.62 mm; hind tibia length 1.14 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dorsal surface of the head yellowish brown, the head capsule sutures very distinct; vertex and genae pale yellowish brown; frons tinged yellowish brown, with a pale band at the transverse suture much wider than the frontal suture; postclypeus and labrum pale orange-yellow, the latter with a deep red spot at each end; thoracic and abdominal tergites pale yellowish brown-olive. Head with almost no bristles, widest behind the antennal insertions, narrowing towards the posterior margin. Postclypeus small, strongly convex, less than half as long as wide; anteclypeus about half the length of the postclypeus, its anterior margin distinctly projecting. Antennae 14-segmented. Pronotum far narrower than the head, the anterior half upturned, narrowing anteriorly and with a deep notch, with very few and very short bristles. Measurements: body length 4.50—5.00 mm; head length (to the end of the labrum) 1.45—1.50 mm; head length (to the frontoclypeal suture) 0.93 mm; head width 1.14—1.25 mm; pronotum length 0.28 mm, width 0.68 mm.

sections.label: Nymph
sections.text: First-instar nymph: body length 5.75 mm; head length 1.02 mm, head width 0.97 mm; pronotum length 0.45 mm, width 0.85 mm; antennae 15-segmented; anterior margin of the pronotum distinctly raised, the corners rounded and blunt, the lateral margins narrowing towards the broad and weakly concave posterior margin; wing buds faintly tinged brown.
